title: Clone pair decomposition
statement: Let $r,M$ be natural numbers, and let $i,j\in\text{Fin}(r)$ be distinct. There is a bijection between assignments of an element of $\text{Fin}(M)$ to each coordinate in $\text{Fin}(r)$ and data consisting of the values at $i$ and $j$, together with an assignment of values to all coordinates different from both $i$ and $j$.
